summary: The base's real SchedulerLoadInquirer.get_loads() counts only the currently selected running_batch and reports 1 for four unique requests retained across PP slots. The exact candidate exposes all PP running_mbs and counts unique request IDs, reports 4 in the same full-snapshot fixture, preserves singleton non-PP behavior, and passes independent duplicate-ID and empty-slot boundaries. No scheduler-accounting counterexample was found.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before execution of the actual get_loads method: observed num_running_reqs=1 while four unique request IDs were retained across three representative PP slots. See evidence/base-full-snapshot-contract.log.
Passing-after execution of the actual get_loads method: observed all four unique request IDs across PP slots. See evidence/candidate-full-snapshot-contract.log.

16 tests passed on the exact candidate, covering its regression, independent four-slot phase coverage, cross-slot duplicate IDs represented by distinct objects, singleton non-PP and all-empty boundaries, existing waiting-token behavior, and /v1/loads response behavior. See evidence/candidate-focused-and-adversarial-importlib.log.
Both changed Python source files compile successfully.

gpu_execution_evidence: Environment inventory found one AMD Instinct MI350X with gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. The original TP=2, PP=4 reproduction requires eight GPUs and NVIDIA H20 was not available. The corrected code is CPU scheduler bookkeeping; no GPU kernel was executed or claimed. See evidence/base-environment-and-imports.log.
remaining_limitations: The original 16-request TP=2, PP=4 HTTP serving workload was not run because only one gfx950 GPU was assigned and model weights were not supplied.

The review verifies the actual scheduler snapshot path with representative PP slot state, but not multi-GPU pipeline communication, full-model execution, NVIDIA H20 behavior, or end-to-end HTTP timing.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable or performed.

A combined pytest run without --import-mode=importlib encountered an existing duplicate module basename collection collision between two test_load_inquirer.py files; the recorded importlib-mode rerun passed all 16 tests.
